title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues §X, 'Étude des groupes M_{ρ,σ} et de M_{ρ,σ} → Gl(2)'. On the previous page, M_{ρ,σ} is built as a semidirect product S𝒢^{**}_{ρ,σ}(ω)·SG. It sits inside (T_ρ × N'_σ)·G. Here T_ρ is a torus, N'_σ is a (variant of a) torus normalizer, and the action on G = Gl(2)_S goes through N'_σ →det→ G_m ≃ T_0 ⊂ G. A homomorphism Θ: x·y·z·f ↦ x·f was defined on the larger group, and it factors through the quotient that identifies i_B(λ) with i_G(λ).

On this page Grothendieck restricts Θ to the induced homomorphism (4) θ: M_{ρ,σ} → G ≃ Gl(2)_S. He proves it is an epimorphism:
- Its image trivially contains SG = SL(2), since SG is a factor of the semidirect product.
- So it suffices that the composite with G/SG →det→ G_m (≅) is epi.
- That composite equals a map χ: the canonical projection M_{ρ,σ} → S𝒢^{**}_{ρ,σ}(0), followed by a 'multiplication' map to G_m, (α,β,μ,ε) ↦ μ.
- This map is epi. In the coordinates of (6)/(7), i.e. the embedding S𝒢^{**}_{ρ,σ}(0) ↪ T_ρ × N'_σ, it is (a,b) ↦ det b, with a reference to chapter VIII, p. 189, formula (25).

He then defines (8) M^+_{ρ,σ} := Ker(M_{ρ,σ} →δ→ G_m). This sets up the morphism of short exact sequences of the next page, (9):
- top row: 1 → M^+ → M → Ẑ^* → 1;
- bottom row: 1 → SG → G →det→ Ẑ^* → 1;
- θ restricts to M^+ → SG.

The purpose is to analyse the group M_{ρ,σ} attached to elliptic-type relations of orders ρ, σ, and its 'linear' quotient Gl(2). This feeds the next page's composition series 1 ⊂ I ⊂ J ⊂ M, where J is a radical-like (expected commutative) subgroup. The context is the study of the 'équation des lacets' (loop/braid-type relations, Teichmüller/Galois–Teichmüller setting) in the sequel to La Longue Marche.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The argument that θ is epi is standard: the image contains SL2, and the composite with det is onto, so the image is all of GL2 (as a group scheme or fppf sheaf this needs SG ⊂ image, which holds). The surjectivity of (a,b) ↦ det b on S𝒢^{**}(0) is only asserted with a cross-reference, not proved here. There is notational drift: the target of det is G_m on this page but Ẑ^* on the next page, presumably a profinite/arithmetic specialization.

ideas.what: Surjectivity of a homomorphism onto GL2 via containing SL2 plus surjectivity of the determinant composite
ideas.modern_name: elementary criterion for surjectivity onto GL_n (SL_n ⊂ image and det onto)

ideas.what: Kernel of the 'determinant/character' map δ: M_{ρ,σ} → G_m and the morphism of exact sequences to 1→SL2→GL2→G_m→1
ideas.modern_name: morphism of group extensions; 'special' subgroup as kernel of a character

ideas.what: Semidirect-product groups M_{ρ,σ} built from tori T_ρ and normalizers N'_σ acting on GL2, as models for groups defined by order-ρ,σ relations
ideas.modern_name: unclear; possibly algebraic models of triangle/modular-type groups (e.g. PSL2(Z) ≅ Z/2*Z/3) mapping to GL2
ideas.where_published: unpublished sequel to La Longue Marche (cote 140-3)

deep.surprise_reason: This page is a routine verification inside a longer unpublished construction: θ is epi, and a kernel is defined. The surrounding programme (the groups M_{ρ,σ}) may be of interest, but this page adds no non-routine result or connection.
transcription_corrections: Line 'or ce composé est aussi l'hom. composé (avec χ)' probably reads '... composé / (noté χ)' or 'encore χ'. The handwriting is uncertain, but 'avec' seems unlikely.
Above SG in (5) the mark is likely '≃' (written like '21'), i.e. M_{ρ,σ} ≃ S𝒢^{**}_{ρ,σ}(0)·SG, not '?'.
In (6) the crossed-out text before T_ρ × N'_σ is a deleted product (something like 'T_0 × T_ρ'); the arrow is '=' or '↪', overwritten.
(8) defines M^+_{ρ,σ} (superscript +, consistent with the next page), not M^*. The subscript is ρ,σ (the 'α' is a misreading).
'en aura donc une suite de suites exactes' should be 'on aura donc un diagramme de suites exactes' or similar; the final words are uncertain.
